text:
deploy-bot: HOLD placed due to incident in eu-west-1 — ingress 503 spike, rolling canaries paused. All release slots frozen. Reason: ingress-error-rate > 5% :rotating_light:
eng-release-lead-anna: ack, thanks. can we scope the blast radius? which parts of this release touch ingress?
sre-jordan: the spike looks upstream (load-balancer -> api-proxy). Not obviously caused by our client-side change, but the db-migration is risky if we keep rolling. suggest we delay the migration and avoid expanding canary.
pm-luis: FYI release includes: ranking tweak (non-breaking), client metric naming, and a small DB migration to add a nullable column. user-facing risk mainly from migration.
carla: the migration is behind a feature-flag toggle. we can flip it off without rolling back code. that would avoid a schema rollback.
eng-release-lead-anna: proposal: split the rollout. 1) pin prod to current stable (v3.1.3), 2) roll back canary to v3.1.3 to be safe, 3) flip feature flag for migration to safe, 4) reschedule migration for next change window. If infra stabilizes, we can resume staged canary to 5% then full.
ops-max: if we need immediate mitigation i can run rollback+pin. estimate 15m. recommend ops do rollback and pin now, then later we re-run the client-only deploy.
sre-jordan: agree. also confirm kernel/kv-cache tweak in the canary is unrelated to LB spike; safe to keep once pinned. but prefer rollback now to eliminate variables.
deploy-bot: ACTIONS queued: 
- ops-max: rollback canary -> v3.1.3 and pin prod -> v3.1.3
- eng-release-lead-anna & carla: flip migration feature flag to OFF
- pm-luis: update release notes & notify support + doc change window reschedule
- sre-jordan: monitor ingress/error-rate and signal when <2% for 30m before resuming
eng-release-lead-anna: add to release notes: "resume only after ingress <2% sustained 30m, QA regression passed on canary"
pm-luis: will update release notes and post a support update. I'll also draft the new change window for tomorrow 02:00 UTC.
carla: i'll flip the feature flag as soon as ops completes the rollback.
ops-max: running rollback now:
```bash
deployctl rollback --env=canary --version=v3.1.3 && deployctl pin --env=prod --version=v3.1.3
```
ops-max: done — rollback executed at 6215554380. canary instances now at v3.1.3. pin confirmed. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: update: HOLD confirmed at 6215554321, rollback applied at 6215554380. will post periodic status updates here.
sre-jordan: monitoring — ingress errors trending down, currently 3.1% and decreasing. will report at 30m mark.
eng-release-lead-anna: thanks all. We'll reconvene on this thread for go/no-go. keep replies short here.
